external_entities.name: Shopper
external_entities.description: A person who browses the storefront, signs in, and places orders.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Shoppers browse the storefront and place orders

external_entities.name: Card processor
external_entities.description: A third-party payment processor that settles payments and sends payment status callbacks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our card processor is a third party.

processes.name: Storefront API
processes.description: A Node service running on Cloud Run through which shoppers browse and place orders, and which receives payment webhooks.
processes.source_excerpt: the storefront API, a Node service running on Cloud Run

processes.name: Order service
processes.description: A Python worker in the core network that processes orders, accesses the orders database, and writes receipts.
processes.source_excerpt: The order service is a Python worker in our core network
processes.notes: The worker's database password comes from an environment variable.

data_stores.name: orders-db
data_stores.description: A PostgreSQL database containing orders, shopper addresses, and card-last-four values.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Orders, shopper addresses and card-last-four live in a PostgreSQL database (orders-db)

data_stores.name: Receipt archive
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket containing completed-order receipts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a receipt written to a Cloud Storage bucket we call the receipt archive
data_stores.notes: The receipt records which order was written and that the order service wrote it.

data_flows.name: browse storefront
data_flows.description: Shopper browsing interaction with the storefront API.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Shopper signs in to the storefront API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Shoppers sign in with email and password and get a session cookie
data_flows.authentication: email and password; session cookie; MFA: none

data_flows.name: place orders
data_flows.description: Shopper submits an order to the storefront API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a shopper submits an order
data_flows.data_description: Order information, shopper address, and card-last-four

data_flows.name: submit order
data_flows.description: The storefront API calls the order service when a shopper submits an order.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the storefront API calls the order service over gRPC

data_flows.name: read-write orders
data_flows.description: The order service reads and writes orders and related shopper and payment data in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the order service reads and writes with a single application account that has full read/write
data_flows.authentication: single application account with full read/write

data_flows.name: write receipt
data_flows.description: The order service writes a receipt for each completed order to the receipt archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every completed order also gets a receipt written to a Cloud Storage bucket
data_flows.data_description: Receipt identifying the order and the order service that wrote it

data_flows.name: settlement webhook
data_flows.description: The card processor posts a webhook to the storefront API after settling a payment.
data_flows.source_excerpt: After they settle a payment they POST a webhook back to the storefront API to tell us the order is paid.
data_flows.notes: Authentication is uncertain: "I would have to check how that callback is authenticated."

trust_boundaries.name: Core network
trust_boundaries.description: The core network in which the order service runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The order service is a Python worker in our core network

assumptions.assumption: The orders-db contents are confidential because they include shopper addresses and card-last-four values.
assumptions.basis: The source states that orders-db contains shopper addresses and card-last-four values.

assumptions.assumption: The receipt archive contents are confidential because the receipts record completed orders and payment-related order status.
assumptions.basis: The source states that completed orders produce receipts and that the card processor reports when an order is paid.
